description: Defines the QuicPollEventLoop class, a portable implementation of QuicEventLoop using poll(2), including socket registration, alarm management, and event processing for QUIC protocol handling.

classes.name: QuicPollEventLoop
classes.description: Implements a portable event loop using poll(2) for QUIC, managing socket events and alarms.

classes.name: QuicPollEventLoop::Alarm
classes.description: Represents an alarm within the event loop, capable of scheduling and firing.

classes.name: QuicPollEventLoop::AlarmFactory
classes.description: Creates alarms for the event loop.

methods.name: QuicPollEventLoop
methods.description: Constructor initializing the event loop with a clock.

methods.name: SupportsEdgeTriggered
methods.description: Indicates whether edge-triggered mode is supported (returns false).

methods.name: RegisterSocket
methods.description: Registers a socket with specified events and listener.

methods.name: RearmSocket
methods.description: Rearms a socket with new events.

methods.name: ArtificiallyNotifyEvent
methods.description: Manually triggers an event notification for a socket.

methods.name: RunEventLoopOnce
methods.description: Runs the event loop once with a default timeout.

methods.name: PollSyscall
methods.description: Performs the poll system call, can be mocked for testing.

methods.name: ComputePollTimeout
methods.description: Calculates the timeout for poll based on alarms.

methods.name: ProcessAlarmsUpTo
methods.description: Fires alarms scheduled up to a certain time.

methods.name: DispatchIoEvent
methods.description: Dispatches I/O events for a socket.

methods.name: PollWithRetries
methods.description: Performs poll with retries on EINTR.
